Studies, verses and places, by the words you remember or by what you mean. Exact words work in every version.
TRY ASKING
Why does God allow suffering?
God is faithful when I am afraid
Who decided which books belong in the Bible?
I keep doubting whether I am really saved
the stone which the builders rejected
Jerusalem
MEANING SEARCH
Search by what you mean, not just the words you remember.
“God is faithful when I am afraid” finds Psalm 56:11, “I will not be afraid”. A small model runs on your own device: free, private, and no internet needed once it’s set up.
What you can search
Studies 25 guided answers to hard questions, from suffering to the Trinity.
Verses by meaning 31,098 verses of the World English Bible, matched by what they say.
Places 1,252 places on the atlas, from Ur to Rome.
Exact words Any word or phrase in 37 versions, with where it falls in the Bible.
Or browse by topic
5,603 topics in 55 families, each with the passages that speak to it.
01God and his word
Who God is and what he does, his names, the Holy Spirit, and the Bible: its books, its story and its pictures.
Who God is
God's nature and character: one God in three persons, holy, loving, just and almighty.
What God does
Creation, providence, protection, promises and miracles: God at work in the world.
Names of God
The names and titles by which God makes himself known.
The Holy Spirit
The person and work of the Spirit, in Christ and in believers.
The books of the Bible
All 66 books: what each is, who wrote it, and what it is about.
The word & how it came to us
Scripture's authority and power, its languages, and how the Bible was written, gathered and translated.
Prophecy, types & figures
Prophecy and visions, and the types, figures and signs through which Scripture speaks.
02Jesus and his church
Who Jesus is, his names, life, miracles, parables and cross, the people around him, and the church he gathers.
Who Jesus is
The person of Christ: truly God and truly man, sinless, eternal, and his people's union with him.
Names & titles of Jesus
Messiah, Son of God, Son of Man, Shepherd, Prophet, Priest and King.
The life of Jesus
His birth, family, temptation, ministry, prayers and example, and the prophecies he fulfilled.
Miracles of Jesus
The signs Jesus did, one by one: healings, power over nature, demons cast out and the dead raised.
Parables & teaching
The parables of Jesus, one by one, and the parables and allegories of the rest of Scripture.
Cross, resurrection & return
His sufferings and atoning death, his resurrection and ascension, his kingdom and his coming again.
People of the New Testament
Jesus' family, his apostles and friends, the early church and its opponents.
The church & its ministers
The church's nature, life and discipline, its ministers and mission, its ordinances and fellowship.
03Sin, salvation and the life to come
What went wrong and its judgment, how God puts it right, how the saved now live, and what lies beyond death.
Sin & temptation
The fall, the sinful heart, temptation, turning from God and the ways of the ungodly.
Sins & vices
Sins of speech and conduct, and idolatry and false worship.
Judgment
God's judgments in this life, and the resurrection and last judgment.
Salvation
How sinners are rescued and made new by God's grace in Christ.
Virtues & graces
Who believers are, the graces of the heart, godly conduct and their duties to God and others.
Prayer & devotion
Prayer of every kind, praise, thanksgiving, fasting and worship.
Trials & comfort
Suffering, persecution and temptation, and the joy, peace and comfort God gives.
Death, heaven & hell
Death and the grave, heaven and hell, and the angels and spirits.
04Worship and other gods
The worship God gave Israel, its priests, offerings, feasts and law, and the gods and practices of the nations.
The tabernacle & temples
The tabernacle, Solomon's, the second and Herod's temples, and their holy things.
Priests & Levites
The priesthood, its garments and consecration, and the Levites' service.
Sacrifices & offerings
The offerings of the law, all pointing to Christ.
Feasts & holy days
The sabbath and Israel's appointed feasts and fasts.
Law, covenant & cleanness
God's law and covenants, vows, and clean and unclean.
Idols & other religions
The gods of the nations, their worship, and magic and divination.
05People of the Bible
Everyone in the Old Testament story, era by era, with the women of the Bible and the rulers of the nations.
In the beginning
From Adam to the tower of Babel: the first generations and the nations after the flood.
The patriarchs
Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph, and their wives, sons and households.
Exodus & wilderness
Moses, Aaron and Miriam, and the people of the exodus and the wilderness years.
Joshua & the judges
The conquest of Canaan, the judges who rescued Israel, and the days of Ruth.
The united kingdom
Samuel, Saul, David and Solomon, with their courts, armies and families.
Kings of Israel & Judah
The divided kingdom, from Jeroboam and Rehoboam to the fall of Jerusalem.
Exile & return
Daniel and Esther in exile, and Zerubbabel, Ezra and Nehemiah at the return.
Women of the Bible
Mothers, queens, prophetesses and disciples: the women of the story.
Rulers of the nations
Pharaohs, emperors and foreign kings, and the foreigners of the story.
06Places of the Bible
Jerusalem, the land region by region, the empires around it, its nations and tribes, and its mountains and waters.
Jerusalem
The city of David and the temple: Zion, its hills, gates, walls, pools and valleys.
Judah & the Negev
The towns of Judah, the Shephelah and the Negev.
Samaria & Galilee
The central hill country and the north.
Beyond the Jordan & the coast
Gilead, Bashan, Moab, Ammon and Edom, and the coastal plain and Philistia.
Egypt, Sinai & the wilderness
Egypt's cities, the wilderness stations of the exodus, and the deserts of the story.
Empires east & west
Syria, Mesopotamia and Persia; Asia Minor, Greece and Rome; and the great empires.
Nations & tribes
The tribes of Israel, the Jewish people, and the nations around them.
Mountains, waters & landmarks
Mountains and hills, rivers and seas, valleys and plains, wells and springs, and named landmarks.
07Life in the Bible's world
Family, government and law, work and crafts, home, war and health, music and learning, and the created world.
Marriage & family
Husbands, wives, parents and children, households, neighbours and the poor.
Government & law
Rulers, courts and judges, oaths and punishments, crime and its penalties.
Work, wealth & trade
Labour and wealth, trades and occupations, money and measures, travel and ships.
Precious things & crafts
Gold, silver, stones and spices, and the crafts that worked them.
Home, food & dress
Daily life: houses, meals, farming, clothing and customs.
War & armies
Armies and soldiers, weapons and armour, battles and sieges.
Body, health & healing
The body, sickness and disease, physicians and healing.
Music, writing & time
Music and its instruments, writing and learning, and the reckoning of time.
Creation & nature
The heavens and the earth, seas and weather, and the creatures and plants God made.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
